events.verdict: Although Porzingis (ATL) lowers his arms to contest Zubac's (LAC) shot attempt near the rim, the contact is marginal.
Porzingis (ATL) is established in a position in Collins' (LAC) path and absorbs the contact.
Dunn (LAC) makes contact with Porzingis' (ATL) arm, which affects his jump shot attempt.
Johnson (ATL) reaches in during Collins' (LAC) drive to the basket and any contact that occurs is marginal.
Daniels (ATL) legally contests Dunn's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Johnson (ATL) places a hand on Zubac's (LAC) back before releasing away to retrieve the rebound.
Collins (LAC) legally contests Porzingis' (ATL) jump shot attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on Porzingis (ATL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Porzingis makes illegal foot to foot contact with Harden (LAC), affecting his shot attempt.
Collins (LAC) cleanly blocks the shot attempt prior to when the ball reaches its apex.

Krejci (ATL) makes illegal foot to foot contact with Harden (LAC) as he returns to the floor. After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the foul does not meet the criteria for a flagrant foul.
Jones Jr. (LAC) makes clean contact with the ball to steal it away from Risacher (ATL).
Krejci (ATL) legally contests Harden's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Dunn (LAC) commits a take foul on Risacher (ATL).
Krejci (ATL) makes clean contact to the ball and dislodges it from Batum's (LAC) possession.
